title: "Krig Vs r5r"
author: "Sananthaa J S"

output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
```

```{r load-data}
final_df_complete <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/DATA/final_df_complete.rds")

compare_df <- final_df_complete %>%
  filter(
    urban_rural == "Urban",
    !is.na(perc_active),
    !is.na(krig_value),
    !is.na(access_walk_30),
    !is.na(access_cycle_20),
    krig_value > 0,
    access_walk_30 > 0,
    access_cycle_20 > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_krig     = log1p(krig_value),
    log_walk_30  = log1p(access_walk_30),
    log_cycle_20 = log1p(access_cycle_20)
  )

cat("Urban CSAs for comparison:", nrow(compare_df), "\n")
```

```{r scatter-plots}
p_krig <- plot_ly(compare_df,
        x = ~log_krig, y = ~perc_active,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(opacity = 0.3, color = "#e74c3c", size = 4),
        text = ~paste("Kriging (log):", round(log_krig, 2),
                      "<br>Active travel:", round(perc_active, 1), "%"),
        hoverinfo = "text") %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Kriging school place density"),
    yaxis = list(title = "% active travel"),
    title = "Kriging"
  )

p_walk <- plot_ly(compare_df,
        x = ~log_walk_30, y = ~perc_active,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(opacity = 0.3, color = "#2980b9", size = 4),
        text = ~paste("Walk accessibility (log):", round(log_walk_30, 2),
                      "<br>Active travel:", round(perc_active, 1), "%"),
        hoverinfo = "text") %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Reachable by walking"),
    yaxis = list(title = "% active travel"),
    title = "r5r Walking"
  )

p_cycle <- plot_ly(compare_df,
        x = ~log_cycle_20, y = ~perc_active,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(opacity = 0.3, color = "#27ae60", size = 4),
        text = ~paste("Cycle accessibility (log):", round(log_cycle_20, 2),
                      "<br>Active travel:", round(perc_active, 1), "%"),
        hoverinfo = "text") %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Reachable by cycling"),
    yaxis = list(title = "% active travel"),
    title = "r5r Cycling"
  )

subplot(p_krig, p_walk, p_cycle,
        nrows = 1,
        shareY = TRUE,
        titleX = TRUE) %>%
  layout(
    title      = "Kriging vs Travel Time accessibility - Urban CSA",
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

```{r correlation-bar}
cor_df <- data.frame(
  method = c("Kriging", "r5r Walking", "r5r Cycling"),
  correlation = c(
    cor(compare_df$log_krig,     compare_df$perc_active, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(compare_df$log_walk_30,  compare_df$perc_active, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(compare_df$log_cycle_20, compare_df$perc_active, use = "complete.obs")
  )
)

ggplot(cor_df, aes(x = method, y = correlation, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(correlation, 3)), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Kriging"      = "#e74c3c",
    "r5r Walking"  = "#2980b9",
    "r5r Cycling"  = "#27ae60"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation with active travel - Urban CSAs (log normalised)",
    x     = "",
    y     = "Pearson correlation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
